L8004000.name: Sì Passione
L8004000.description: Powerful reinterpretation of the classic feminine fragrance, Sì Passione is enriched with a new dimension - which Giorgio Armani defines as "an irresistible combination of grace, strength and a spirit of independence". An intense and decisive perfume, designed for a determined woman who dares to say yes. Proposed in a bright red bottle, Sì Passione is a luminous and sensual perfume that instills confidence, charm and strength. Fresh and bright in the opening, Sì Passione is dominated by spicy notes of pink pepper for a great adrenaline effect, while lively and radiant pear accents, once attracted attention, illuminate the iconic blackcurrant nectar for a bold touch of style. The floral heart beats passionately on the feminine notes of jasmine and rose, for a powerful perfume that recalls a woman who is apparently fragile, but capable of showing extraordinary strength if guided by passion. The addition of heliotrope makes the fragrance even more irresistible and transforms it into an invitation to indulge in small luxuries and pleasures, while the warmth and sensuality of vanilla and cedar wood essence reflect that sense of security that the wearer feels. LB402700.name: My Way
LB402700.description: My Way is an invitation to open your horizons and experience meaningful encounters all over the world. A luminous bouquet of white flowers is enclosed in a bottle that resembles a talisman: a metaphor for the world. MY WAY contains discoveries and connections dedicated to a curious, authentic woman, in search of experiences that challenge preconceptions, to live meaningful encounters all over the world. This feminine fragrance is made from the best natural ingredients. In the top notes, Bergamot meets Orange Blossoms from Egypt, creating a brilliant luminosity; the heart opens up in a radiant bouquet of Tuberose and Jasmine from India. Finally, the base notes: a harmony composed of a sensual Premium Bourbon Vanilla from Madagascar, vibrant nuances of Virginia Cedarwood and delicate White Musks. The blue and gold cap is a metaphor for the world. Blue is the universal color, which unites each of us. It is surrounded by a gold ring, engraved with the signature 'Giorgio Armani', to symbolize a journey enriched by every single encounter. This luxurious fragrance is refillable. Remember a talisman that encompasses all meaningful encounters. I AM WHAT I LIVE.

LC647600.name: My Way Intense
LC647600.description: A floral bouquet, powerful and luminous, with a woody and penetrating trail that contains unique experiences and authentic encounters lived around the world. Live your way, intensely. My Way Intense invites you to set out to discover yourself, on a journey made up of encounters full of meaning and important experiences. The fragrance opens on bright notes of orange blossom from Egypt. A new, intense heart of Indian tuberose reveals a soft and velvety side of the floral signature. At the bottom, the New Caledonian sandal takes on an irresistibly creamy character thanks to the encounter with the voluptuous Madagascar vanilla. A FRAGRANCE FOR THE FUTURE. Madagascar vanilla comes from local programs that support the most disadvantaged communities according to the principles of fair trade. A refillable bottle, designed to last. My Way offers an innovative refill system that allows you to unscrew and refill any size at home - from 30, 50 or 90 ml - reducing carbon emissions by 60% * and the use of plastic by 64%. A commitment to reduce the environmental footprint. Giorgio Armani engages in forest protection programs in Madagascar, Zimbabwe, Peru and Brazil.
